additional_context: The current source uses operationdefinition-ValueSet-validate-code.xml rather than valueset-spreadsheet.xml. ValueSet is an active resource in fhir.ini and its operation list references OperationDefinition/ValueSet-validate-code. Later FHIR-52907 added the system-version/check-system-version/force-system-version canonical parameter family and explicitly distinguishes system-version from systemVersion.
reconciliation: No source change was necessary. The active OperationDefinition defines input valueSetVersion and input systemVersion, and a namespace-aware XML parameter check found no remaining input parameter named version on ValueSet $validate-code.
